event_name: FIA Formula One World Championship Mexican Grand Prix Saturday Post-Qualifying Press Conference Transcript
from: THE FLOOR Q: (Scott Mitchell – Autosport) Question for the two Red Bull drivers. Daniel, you mentioned that the first sector wasn't that good. How good were the second and third sectors? How good did the rest of that lap feel? And Max, you mentioned the problem that you had. Given that you had that problem through qualifying and before, did you feel vulnerable going into the final runs and was there anything else on that final lap that meant you didn't improve.
title: Mex Gp Satpressconftranscript Final 0
to: be honest, the first sector wasn't that good, so I was surprised to have probably got the pole after that, but I saw the second and third sector were strong and that's where I made the difference. But I wasn't convinced after the first sector that I was on for pole, put it that way. I knew the previous lap wasn't particularly clean and I was able to get a bit more out of it. It was fun, it was very close, but it felt good. Qualifying can be exciting sometimes and today it proved that.
